0.0: Mh..? Is that a name tag?
0.1: Quite a... uh... peculiar gift, colleague. I guess you really care about the fact that I don't remember my name.
0.2: I won't certainly start wearing a leash with this attached, but sure, call me whatever you want.

1.0: Another name tag? You have a unique way of telling me that you want to call me something else, colleague.
1.1: Sure, it makes no difference to me anyway.

rename.2: Uh, quite self-explanatory I must say. Maybe it's better if you actually come up with a proper personal name.
rename.3: Uh, quite self-explanatory I must say. Maybe it's better if you actually come up with a proper personal name.
rename.4: Colleague, I know you may have put your heart into choosing this name, but I also have standards.
rename.5: Colleague, do I look like a bean to you?
rename.6: Colleague, do I look like a bean to you?
rename.9: I already heard about that expression in a distant land long ago, and I prefer not to use that name. Don't ask why, you wouldn't get it.

10.0: Sabaku? Isn't there a language from a distant place in which it means "desert"? I recall some old fables where a certain 'Sabaku II' was a hero with a golden helmet, wandering through a dark world.
10.1: The fable also spoke of his apprentice, but his name has been lost to time.
10.2: Anyway, this name seems dear to you, colleague, but it doesn't belong to me, I'm sorry.

rename.11: The name of the old king? I don't want the name of someone who abandoned his people when they most needed him, Sorry, colleague.
rename.12: The name of the Ancient Archer? Colleague, perhaps you overestimated me, the effects of my aim are comparable to those of a landslide in the middle of a desert. Please, think of something else.

13.0: The name of the Cursed Wolf? Colleague, as much as I like dogs, I'd prefer to avoid being called like the mastiff that used to slaughter the enemy legions.
13.1: ...And in all this, I'm assuming you didn't expect me to start barking for you.

rename.14: The name of the Explosive Cube? Colleague, have I ever given the impression of wanting to blow up? I purposely scattered the surroundings with anti-Creeper excrements, no thank you.

15.0: The name of the first victim of the Night of the Diamond Swords? It was a terrible event, one of many from that war...
15.1: Forgive me, but I don't want a name that recalls such a tragic event.

16.0: The name of the Lava Eater? Colleague, I certainly don't share his fetish, nor his mastery in forging weapons, why should I use his name?
16.1: Unless this is a wish for me to end up roasted, I find it rather senseless.

17.0: The name of the Builder of Everything, eh? I must say, I admired him a lot as a child, in my village we had a huge statue in his image.
17.1: Surely it's thanks to him that civilization has remained intact to this day, although not as splendid as before. It's said that Ruslan went mad a long time ago, maybe he found something bigger than him?
17.2: Oh, sorry colleague, I'm rambling. Anyway, I don't feel worthy of bearing such a name.

rename.18: Colleague, no. I know very well what that name tag does, and I don't want to suffer its effects, thank you.
rename.19: Colleague, no. I know very well what that name tag does, and I don't want to suffer its effects, thank you.
rename.20: Jeb_, huh? Sorry colleague, my lab coat doesn't have the ability to change color, if that's what you were hoping for. The name fits me, though.

21.0: Oh, funny that you chose this name for me, it was the name of the bunny I had when I was little.
21.1: Now that I think about it, it's strange that I remember his name but not mine, don't you think?
21.2: I gladly accept it, in his honor...

22.0: Johnny? How strange, just the thought of being called that excites me, I feel like I can face any enemy, hostile or not!
22.1: I gladly accept it, this grit might save me in desperate situations.

23.0: The name on this name tag... It's so... familiar...
23.1: Manfredo, Manfredo... repeating it gives me a strange feeling... Could it be my old name? Damn, I can't remember...
23.2: Oh, sorry, I was babbling to myself.
23.3: I gladly accept it, I don't mind having it as a name.
